subject.title: fix(irc): chunk PRIVMSG on UTF-16 boundary to avoid lone surrogates

question: Should maintainers land this focused UTF-16-safe IRC splitter now, or pause it to combine with the adjacent byte-limit chunker PR?
rationale: Both PRs are proofed and touch the same shared sendPrivmsg loop, so the code is reviewable but the final sequencing choice is maintainer-owned message-delivery risk management.

options.title: Merge focused splitter fix
options.body: Land this bounded surrogate fix now and require the byte-limit PR to rebase and preserve the same invariant afterward.

options.title: Pause for combined chunker work
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide whether one combined IRC chunker PR should own surrogate safety and byte limits together.

recommendation.title: Merge focused splitter fix
recommendation.body: Land this bounded surrogate fix now and require the byte-limit PR to rebase and preserve the same invariant afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and also connected to the shared UTF-16 helper lineage this PR uses.
